note: Re-judged 2026-11-08 (independent auditor) after 67700fd37e, d0c2738a48, 78f09955aa, c8e036be19 and f2e3a418ec changed apply.go::applyConfig, releaseSPD and shutdown and unmatched.go::unmatchedPolicies. unmatchedPolicies now delegates to spdCatchAllEntries(family, action, 0), which builds the same in/out/fwd wildcard entries ranked at PriorityUnmatched, at if_id 0. New: each XFRM interface a peer binds is treated as an SPD of its own at its if_id and gets its own DISCARD final entry (unmatched_xfrm_interface.go::interfaceSPDCatchAll, installed by installXFRMInterfaceEntries), with if_id 0 exemptions above the node catch-all; releaseSPD removes the IKE bypass, operator entries, the interface entries, then the node catch-all last, and keeps it when the SPD ledger is not empty. FINDING (weak): RFC 4301 Section 4.4.1: 'Every SPD SHOULD have a nominal, final entry that matches anything that is otherwise unmatched, and discards it.' Ze now runs one SPD per bound XFRM interface besides the node-wide one, and all three tagged units (TestRFC4301DefaultFinalSPDEntryDiscards, TestRFC4301FinalEntryIsUnderEveryZeSPDEntry, TestRFC4301InboundClearPacketIsDiscardedByTheDefaultFinalEntry) judge the if_id 0 SPD alone. A mutant that drops the interface catch-all from installXFRMInterfaceEntries leaves every tagged unit green. The interface final entry is proven only by untagged tests (unmatched_xfrm_interface_test.go TestInterfaceSPDCatchAllEntries, TestApplyInstallsInterfaceSPDCatchAllAndGuard, TestReleaseRemovesInterfaceSPDAndGuard; dataplane/xfrm_xfrmi_catchall_integration_linux_test.go TestRFC4301InterfaceSPDDiscardsUnmatchedInKernel). Also: installXFRMInterfaceEntries only logs a failed install of an interface catch-all and the apply succeeds, so an interface SPD can hold Child SA policies with no final entry until the next commit or address change. Fix: tag the interface catch-all tests for this row, with a recorded break. The node-wide half is still asserted by the tagged units, but the mutant record on TestRFC4301FinalEntryIsUnderEveryZeSPDEntry no longer verifies (producer-changed, ./le rfc check) and owes a re-take. Prior judgement: Re-judged 2026-10-26 at HEAD 635aa08b78 (independent judge, clean clone). Section 4.4.1: "Every SPD SHOULD have a nominal, final entry that matches anything that is otherwise unmatched, and discards it." dc7de8e76f and 000e6fdfea changed the two cited units releaseSPD and warnSPDLeft, and nothing else this verdict cites. releaseSPD's only change is the call warnSPDLeft(log) becoming warnSPDLeft(dp, log). warnSPDLeft now names each leftover through spdLeft.describe(dp), which copies the ledger out under l.mu and asks policyDeleteCommand (inner_selectors.go) for each entry's removal command: dataplane.XFRMPolicyDeleteCommand for xfrmBackend, the recorded spdEntries entry for vppBackend (vppPolicyDelCommand), and a plain text naming the selector when the backend names none or a nil dataplane is passed. policyDeleteCommand always returns a string, so describe still returns exactly one name per ledger entry, and warnSPDLeft still returns true exactly when the ledger holds an entry: the decision to keep the catch-all is unchanged, only the text of the warning is. Probe in the clone (go -overlay, tree untouched): warnSPDLeft made to return false always, and describe made to return no name, each turn TestReleaseSPDKeepsTheCatchAllWhenARemovalFails, TestChildInstallRollbackFailureIsRecordedInTheSPDLedger, TestSPDLeftoverNamesTheExactRemovalCommand and TestSPDLeftoverNamesTheBackendCommand red. The three tagged units are byte-identical to the recorded ones (TestRFC4301DefaultFinalSPDEntryDiscards, TestRFC4301FinalEntryIsUnderEveryZeSPDEntry, TestRFC4301InboundClearPacketIsDiscardedByTheDefaultFinalEntry) and still assert the catch-all's existence, rank and discard. Observation, not a finding: the keep-the-catch-all-at-exit behaviour that these two units carry is proven by the untagged TestReleaseSPDKeepsTheCatchAllWhenARemovalFails, not by a tagged unit. Scope note carried from RFC4301-5.2-1: VPP holds no catch-all and the OSPFv3 RFC 4552 entries have none. Verdict stands.
